windows.client_cpu_rss: process birth through close and state hashing
windows.provider_cpu: process birth through client exit; excludes role shutdown
windows.provider_rss: 50 ms samples after startup through client exit; startup peak unknown
windows.tcp_streams: native relays from topology startup through provider/network close
windows.covered_bodies: client construction through close, v3 counters only
windows.aggregate_cpu: complete cell including launcher, relays and reaped client/role children
windows.ttft: request start through first text; all admission/preparation waiting charged
windows.decode_tps: N-1 / first-to-last text delta; all epoch pauses charged

limits: no private-output policy optimization or cross-salt pooling
cold one-response client: no generated-prefix reuse savings claimed
full-cap geometry remains admitted, including unused issued/reserved rows
v3 base/output attribution may be partial; residual conserves totals
publisher/checkpoint/tokenizer distribution and disk separate and unknown
remote body gate means scheduled body projection MACs, not whole CPU or all operator FLOPs
physical wire, Internet RTT and independent launcher peak RSS unknown

checks.admission_scope: full-cap shared topology, retained state, caller metadata, launcher and relays; not measured RSS
